quest.title: Busy Adventurers' Guild
quest.description: The Adventurers' Guild is taking on a growing number of commissions, and Katheryne is finding it hard to keep up.

choices.text: No problem, I've been well looked after.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I am delighted to hear that. In which case, let me try to make this quick...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: We are most grateful for your commission completion to date. The guild's reputation has grown stronger as a result.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: However, another consequence is that we are receiving an unprecedented number of requests — more than our current numbers can handle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You want us to do some recruitment for you?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Ahh... No. Although I appreciate the offer — it would be fantastic to have some new members...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: But scrambling to officially recruit new members at this stage would not really solve our immediate problems.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: So what I want to ask is — Would your friends have the time to help out?

choices.text: I'll need to check with them.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Great, please do. Thank you!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Right now, we urgently need to find people for our <color=#00E1FFFF>expeditions</color>.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Expeditions?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: We organize expeditions to explore areas around the city and in the wilderness. It is a way to keep ourselves informed of any emerging dangers, unusual activity in the domains, and so on.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Since expeditions are not commissioned by a third party, there are no strict deadlines for completion.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: However, we neglect them at our peril. If trouble were to foment unchecked, it could easily turn into a major disaster.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pretty important then!

choices.text: I'm sure my friends will understand.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: All you need to do is convince them to help. I will take care of all the details.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Now, without further ado, let me show you the expeditions that are currently available.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Check Expeditions

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Rest assured that the Guild does not take a cut of the spoils from expeditions. Everything goes to you and your friends.

choices.text: You want me to convince all my friends to join the Guild?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: No no, that is not what I meant. I know that your friends come from all walks of life, and asking them to become official members may be impractical.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: My request is of the more presumptuous kind... The Guild needs a favor.

choices.text: There's a new reward up for grabs?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Hahaha... Bingo! And I presume you are interested.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You can dispatch someone on an expedition at any time, and they will still be able to join you in your adventures should you need them.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You can also choose the length of time for the expedition. After your friend returns, just come here and confirm the outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: As your Adventure Rank increases, more dangerous expeditions will become available to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After all, with epic power comes epic responsibility!

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: And of course, matching risk with experience is also for everyone's safety.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Thanks again for your help. I hope you and your friends can help out with our expeditions as much as possible.
